decision: Source accepted; native peer changed-contract receiving passed; final current-main and supported-Windows gates remain separate
source_review: Identity mode omits prediction_path; external mode retains its key even with an empty choice. Validation refuses absent/unavailable files without falling through to identity.

Native choice remains literal, including significant whitespace. Cancellation preserves the prior choice. Package changes clear it; revision changes retire delayed choices after package/command/mode/busy changes.
AnalysisJobExtras contributes the new key only to Eval. Existing _AnalysisWorker copies the scalar extra dictionary immediately, so later UI changes cannot rewrite queued parameters.
The new scroll container preserves existing widgets and their order, permits natural control heights, and keeps its minimum width compatible with the existing column.

The common busy predicate now uses reserved thread presence. This disables Run/configuration, enables Cancel before start, and remains active until existing thread-finished cleanup releases the reservation. The matching launch guard refuses another reserved job.

demonstrated_corrections.new_layout_defect: Original native controls clipped; a forced group height overlapped Run. Root identified the actual 1100 by 700 application minimum and lack of a column scroll container. Peer baseline also observed forced 1100 by 881 and 11-pixel controls. The scroll wrapper addresses that measured constraint.
demonstrated_corrections.inherited_busy_defect: Peer observed a real reserved/running QThread with Run enabled and Cancel disabled on source 424. Removing only the new input busy hook recovers the d745 parent screen byte-for-byte. This ancestry distinguishes the inherited defect from the feature.

peer_receiving.original_functional: Four groups, twelve actual Qt dialogs and six real evaluator jobs on exact 424 source; no evaluator requalification claimed by this source review.
peer_receiving.final_changed_contract: Exact 983 source: actual AnalysisScreen at 1280 by 960 and 1100 by 700; actual chooser/Run, one real held worker, keyboard Cancel, then settled and re-enabled controls. Process 31156 completed exit 0 in the peer's recorded 12.57 seconds.
peer_receiving.corrections_retained: Invalid ancestor-map coordinates excluded; forward-Tab assumptions around existing QTextEdit controls corrected to observed Shift+Tab navigation. Original receiver failures retained without product rewrites.

platform_boundary: Actual app.py/MainWindow imports Windows msvcrt and ctypes.WinDLL(kernel32) before auto_connect=False. Mac evidence is actual AnalysisScreen and Qt viewport evidence, not a full MainWindow claim. The added Windows-only test must pass on supported hosted Windows before final integration.
scope: No changes to evaluator, numerical admission/scoring, JobParams, worker implementation, output schema, dependencies, workflows, capture sources or other owners' code beyond the explicit three UI paths. Current-main imported-source equality and final full tree remain publication gates.
